reason: A better addresses the requested coupled-response test by including wear-only, corrosion-only, and simultaneous conditions, measuring both wear and electrochemical responses, and defining synergy relative to the sum of independent losses. Both proposals inadequately isolate micro-galvanic coupling and use a physically problematic example of aqueous chloride near 600°C, but B’s corrosion-only baseline cannot distinguish synergy from the trivial addition of wear or quantify the individual responses.
